detailed_description:
The target video keeps the flat, painterly 2D-animated illustration style of <Video 1>, regraded to a dark late-night palette of deep blues and greens with warm interior accents.
[Shot 1] The camera holds a static shot identical to <Video 1>: a red café counter runs from the foreground toward the windows, with a black kettle, a plate holding a sandwich, orange slices and cherry tomatoes, a folded napkin with a spoon, and a white cup on a saucer. On the right, <Subject 1>, the female barista with dark teal hair in a low bun, a grey puff-sleeved blouse, and a black apron, tilts a round glass pot and pours dark coffee into the cup with exactly the same timing as in <Video 1>, lit by soft warm lamp light from inside the café. Behind her a blue vase of pink flowers stands on the right, and a large potted plant fills the left edge. Through the windows, <Subject 3> is now a late-night street in heavy rain: the sky is black, the white façade with green shutters and balconies is dim and blue-grey, dense rain streaks fall across the whole exterior, water runs off the scalloped green awning in a steady curtain, raindrops slide down the window glass, and the pavement and empty outdoor tables are wet and reflective. The man in the green jacket walks from left to right past the tables, the person with the brown dog walks along the far side of the street, and the cream-colored hatchback drives across from right to left, all with the same paths, speed, and timing as in <Video 1>, now moving through the rain. <Subject 2>, the male barista in a dark shirt and black apron, enters from the left foreground carrying a cup and saucer and leans forward to set it on the counter, exactly as in <Video 1>. At around 00:03.000, as he places the cup, lightning strikes somewhere out of view: no lightning bolt is visible, only a sudden hard flash of light from outside. For a brief instant the street and windows flare bright, the entire café interior drops to near-black, and <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> become dark silhouettes edged with a strong, saturated yellow rim light along their hair, faces, shoulders, and arms. The flash fades within a fraction of a second and the warm interior light and dark rainy street return. A heavy thunderclap follows. <Subject 2> straightens, turns, and walks out of frame to the left, while <Subject 1> finishes pouring and holds the glass pot level in both hands, eyes lowered, as the rain keeps falling outside through the final frame.

overall_soundscape:
Heavy rain pours steadily on the street and drums on the awning throughout the video, with water splashing as the car passes. Coffee trickles into the cup and a cup and saucer clink on the counter. A sharp, close thunderclap cracks just after the flash and rolls away into a low rumble.
